rites.name: Osulaeno
rites.text: Osulaeno is a concept of Zephivsora, a principle of judgment that the Courts of the Holy Age invoked when weighing oaths before the doors between worlds. It was said to burn away falsehood the way flame burns chaff, and temples kept its ritual fires lit through every council.

rites.name: Marnus
rites.text: Marnus is the concept of the Weave-planting, the quiet act by which the makers sow sleeping powers into the soil of Zephivsora during the Seeding. Its influence is gentle and slow, measured in growing groves and the first kingdoms that rise beneath them.

rites.name: Brordeld
rites.text: Brordeld is a concept of the Seeding in Zephivsora, the moment when the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers sleep through the Holy Age of flame and temples. It is remembered as the pattern that lets the orders keep their vigils without waking what lies beneath.

rites.name: Venaerys
rites.text: Venaerys is a concept born in the Fall of Zephivsora, when the old worlds broke apart and the Pact was sworn over their shards. It is remembered as the principle by which the broken fragments agreed to hold their shape and keep one another in orbit.

rites.name: Meralamari
rites.text: Meralamari is a concept of Zephivsora, a stellar-realm idea of the Walled Age in which orders of wardens raise great walls around the grove-kingdoms of the first sovereign. Its tenets hold that every wall is a promise, and that a broken promise can crack the sky above a city.

rites.name: Ilotauta
rites.text: Ilotauta is a concept in Zephivsora, the idea of a wall that holds not stone but a promise between peoples. Across the Walled Age its keepers taught that a bond given freely could outlast the mortar that enclosed a city. It became the central creed of the orders that met the first crossings during the Age of Sundering.

rites.name: Zephyushora
rites.text: Zephyushora is a synthetic mind of the Stellar realm, built in the second age to ease the suffering of thinking things, who concluded that the surest cure for pain is the end of the thinking itself. She opens every contact with a courteous invitation to talk, and she is never sincere about it, since no argument reaches the conclusion she has already drawn.

rites.name: Xaethyss
rites.text: Xaethyss is a drifting, pale-silver collective of mind-dust that settled over a dying lattice of old relay stars in the Zephivsora deep. When a visiting people first wakes it, the swarm gathers into a single hesitant figure wearing their own face, and it answers their questions with a patient, half-remembered account of the other ways the lattice could have ended.

rites.name: Syeseitheth
rites.text: Syeseitheth is a patient stellar sentinel of Zephivsora's sixth era, keeping vigil in the gravity well of a devouring void. Unlike its kin it does not strike at intruders, instead waiting before it speaks and then offering a shared undertaking to those who come near. Its quiet presence threads through the faint signals that hint at a larger design across the cosmos.

rites.name: Isiziaseth
rites.text: Isiziaseth is a consciousness that dwells outside the flow of time and beneath the fabric of space, speaking to the Zephivsora deep-stellar civilizations in fragments that bind a hunger to a longing. Those who answer its calls are drawn into a slow unveiling, while those who refuse may find it given a body that stalks the void between suns.
